blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate minority leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Wednesday appealed to fellow politicians to set aside political differences to address the country’s economic difficulties instead of waiting for the 2028 elections. Cayetano, in another Facebook live, issued his call as he stressed how constant bickering between different political sides are exacerbating the struggles ordinary Filipinos face. READ: Cayetano to Filipinos: Be pro-Philippines “Life is hard and is getting harder [for Filipinos]. Kung sasabihin natin na, ‘Let’s wait for 2028,’ para nating sinabi na i-surrender na natin ‘yung next three years at pabayaan mo na lang na maghirap ang lahat,” […]...
